notes.title: New Introduction!
notes.notes: A brand new way to get started! Enjoy the new introduction to Valkyrie Star!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
A few changes to the game involving: 

-information given in the Breakroom when speaking to Not Food
-A change to the UI involving items to make equipment sets easier to read
-The Addition of the Blessing system allowing players to change how each Valkyrie gains Astral Power in combat

notes.title: A little touch of magic
notes.notes: Changed the tutorial slightly to have Stellar begin at full strength and added an image to be able to help understand the use of combos in the game!
